readme.text:
**
[Features](#star-features) • [Setup](#-setup) • [Screenshots](#camera-screenshots) • [Wiki](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/wiki)
** Welcome! Meelo is a self-hosted music server. It works similarly to Plex, Jellyfin, Koel and Black Candy, but focuses on flexibility, browsing and listening experiences. Actually, Meelo is designed for music collectors. What does it mean? Scroll down to see our killer features :arrow_heading_down: While the software aims to be a flexible as possible, it requires a little bit of setup. However, once everything is ready, you will just have to sit back, relax, and enjoy your music. :sunglasses: ## :star: Features Meelo has all the basic features you might expect from a music player/server (playback, browsing, search, playlists, libraries ...). But it comes with a handful of features that make it unique :star_struck: - Music Videos are first-class citizens - Access them directly from an album's, artist's or song's page - We also differentiate music video from interviews, behind-the-scenes, trailers... - Identifies B-Sides - Meelo shows you any tracks that could be related to an album directly on the album's page! - ... and Rare tracks - And show them on the artist's page, so that these rare gems do not get lost and forgotten! - Automatic 'featuring' and duet detection - Albums have _releases_ - Meaning that you can have multiple versions of a single album - But only its _main_ version would appear on browsing pages - Of course, you can still access its other versions, directly from the album's page - Songs have _tracks_ - It is pretty much the same as for albums and releases - No duplicated songs when browsing your library! - Songs have _versions_ - See an example [here](./assets/examples/song-groups.png) - Album and Song types - Finding instrumental songs or live recordings has never been this simple! - Filter Songs that are exclusive to an album (for compilation albums only) - Supports all formats! - Thanks to transcoding and the way we parse files, any audio and video format is virtually supported - (Note: Transcoding is only used when the file format is not supported in the browser) - Flexible metadata parsing - Use either the embedded metadata or the file's name (or both!) to extract metadata - Also works with album covers! - Get genres, descriptions, and ratings using MusicBrainz, Genius, Wikipedia and many other providers! - Push Scrobbles to ListenBrainz and LastFM! - Download (synced) lyrics or get them from embedded metadata and `.lrc` files Keep track of the upcoming features [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/issues). ## :iphone: Mobile App Meelo has a mobile app for both Android and iOS :tada:. You can find the known issues and the list of upcoming features [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22Front%20(Mobile)%22). - **Android**: You can download the latest stable APK on the release page. More info [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/discussions/1130) - **iOS**: The app is distributed using TestFlight. More info [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/discussions/1533) APKs and IPAs are also built whenever code is pushed to the main branch. Check out [this worklow](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/actions/workflows/front-mobile.yml?query=branch%3Amain) ## 🔧 Setup :whale: Meelo is shipped though Docker images. :point_right: To get started, follow the dedicated [wiki](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/wiki) We love embedded metadata here. Make sure your music is correctly tagged before getting started! > [!NOTE] > If you want to rely on the file paths as metadata sources, you might need to be familiar with Regexes! ## :camera: Screenshots [![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/03d0d877-fc76-4078-96d5-af8e2bec3ad0)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/03d0d877-fc76-4078-96d5-af8e2bec3ad0) :point_right: You can find more screenshots of the UI [here](./docs/screenshots/) >[!NOTE] > Some screenshots may be outdated and may not show the state of the latest version of the app. Some minor details may change (e.g. logo, spacing, etc.) ## :desktop_computer: Live Demo We are actively working on a public demo, so that you can try out Meelo. Stay tuned... ## 🌐 Translation Meelo uses [Weblate](https://weblate.org/en-gb/) to handle translations. Feel free to contribute [here](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/meelo/)! [![Stats](https://hosted.weblate.org/widget/meelo/front/multi-auto.svg)](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/meelo/) 🫂 A big thank you to all the translators who contributed! Any questions about this? Open a discussion [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/discussions/categories/translation)! ## :handshake: Contributing and Bugs reporting :thinking: Is there a feature you would like to have? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/issues/new/choose), and we will be happy to discuss it! :wrench: Need help with the setup process? Open a discussion [here](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/discussions/categories/need-help-with-setting-up). :bug: Have you encountered a bug? Ugh we don't like 'em here! Report it by [opening an issue](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/issues/new/choose). :hammer: Would you like to contribute to Meelo? Feel free to [open a pull request](https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/compare). ## 💖 Our Sponsors Thanks to the amazing folks who support this project:

Want to support Meelo? [Become a sponsor](https://github.com/sponsors/Arthi-chaud) ## :warning: Disclaimer > [!WARNING] > Meelo is intended for private use only! Do not use your instance as a public downloading platform. > It is not intended to support heavy traffic, and it should not be used to illegally share/download copyrighted media. > > The maintainers are not responsible for any misuse of the software. --- Get ready to make the most out of you music collection! [![Coverage (Back-end)](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=arthi-chaud_Meelo-back&metric=coverage)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=arthi-chaud_Meelo-back) [![Maintainability Rating](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=arthi-chaud_Meelo-back&metric=sqale_rating)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=arthi-chaud_Meelo-back) ![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/arthichaud/meelo-server)

items.name: v3.11.0
items.body_excerpt:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## TLDR
- Adds support for areas (artists only), 
- Allows an album to have more than on a 'album artist'
- Many fixes and QoL improvements for the mobile app

**A big thank you** to the sponsors and contributors ❤️ 

## What's Changed
### 🎉 New Features
* Albums can have more than one album artists by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1695
* Add 'Unofficial' and 'Demo' Album Types by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1547
* Add 'loop' queue/track button by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1551
* Get Album Type from Embedded Metadata by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1555
* Get Artists' area from MusicBrainz by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1631
* Play History + sort songs by play date by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1639
#### Mobile
* Add page that lists labels by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1641
* Play/Shuffle songs by label by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1545
* 'Pull to refresh' on home and release page by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1557
* Coverflow view by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1742
#### Web
* Anonymous Access by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1630
* Mobile: Make Notification controls work by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1718

### 👍 Improvements, Optimisations & Enhancements
* Front: Filter out non-first registered releases by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1722
* Web: Add quick play button on genre page by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo/pull/1542
* Web: Add error message when server is unreachable on login page by @Arthi-chaud in https://github.com/Arthi-chaud/Meelo

readme.text:
# Yao — App Runtime for the AI Era

Yao is an open-source runtime for building AI agents and web applications — shipped as a single binary.

![Mission Control](docs/mission-control.png)

**🏠 Homepage:** [https://yaoagents.com](https://yaoagents.com)

**📚 Docs:** [https://yaoagents.com/docs](https://yaoagents.com/docs)

**🖥️ Yao Desktop:** [https://yaoagents.com/download](https://yaoagents.com/download)

---

## How It Works

Think of Yao Agent as a **cage, not an animal**. What you put inside determines the behavior; the cage keeps it controlled.

Every request flows through the same pipeline:

![Pipeline](docs/pipeline.png)

`Create Hook` runs before the executor — inject context, enforce constraints, route requests.  
`Next Hook` runs after — validate output, trigger downstream actions, drive multi-step loops.  
**The AI does the heavy lifting. You define the boundaries.**

### Three Modes

| Mode | Executor | When to use |
|------|----------|-------------|
| **LLM** | OpenAI, Anthropic, etc. | Conversational assistants, Q&A, content generation |
| **CLI Agent** | OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex in a container | Computer use, sandbox isolation, SKILL ecosystem |
| **Pure Hook** | Your own TypeScript code | Deterministic logic, routing, menu flows — no AI needed |

All three share the same Hook interface. You can mix them freely — route some requests through the LLM, handle others with pure code, all inside a single `Create Hook`.

---

## Features

### Agent Framework

- **TypeScript Hooks** — `Create` and `Next` hooks intercept every request; built-in V8 engine
- **Native MCP Support** — Connect tools via process, SSE, or STDIO transport
- **Memory API** — Four scopes: request-level, session, user, team
- **Multi-Agent** — Delegate to specialist agents or call agents in parallel
- **CLI Agent / Sandbox** — Run Claude Code (or other CLI runners) in an isolated container with VNC desktop support
- **Skills Ecosystem** — Drop reusable capability packs (`SKILL.md`) into any CLI Agent

### Full-Stack Runtime

Everything in a single executable:

- **Data Models** — Define database tables and relations in JSON/YAML
- **REST APIs** — Map routes to model queries or TypeScript processors
- **SUI Pages** — Component-based web UI with server-side rendering
- **Chat UI (CUI)** — Built-in conversation interface for agents
- **TypeScript** — Built-in V8 engine; no Node.js required
- **Single Binary** — Runs on ARM64/x64; no Python, Node, or containers needed on the host

### Built-in Search

- **Vector Search** — Embeddings with OpenAI or FastEmbed
- **Knowledge Graph** — Entity-relationship retrieval
- **GraphRAG** — Hybrid vector + graph search

---

## About the Name

Yao (爻, yáo) is the fundamental symbol in the I Ching — the building block of the eight trigrams. Like a binary digit, it has two states. Their combinations describe the patterns of everything.

evidence.excerpt: Think of Yao Agent as a **cage, not an animal**. What you put inside determines the behavior; the cage keeps it controlled.

evidence.title: README (segment 4)
evidence.excerpt: `Create Hook` runs before the executor — inject context, enforce constraints, route requests. `Next Hook` runs after — validate output, trigger downstream actions, drive multi-step loops. **The AI does the heavy lifting. You define the boundaries.**

evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: | Mode | Executor | When to use | |------|----------|-------------| | **LLM** | OpenAI, Anthropic, etc. | Conversational assistants, Q&A, content generation | | **CLI Agent** | OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex in a container | Computer use, sandbox isolation, SKILL ecosystem | | **Pure Hook** | Your own TypeScript code | Deterministic logic, routing, menu flows — no AI needed |

evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: All three share the same Hook interface. You can mix them freely — route some requests through the LLM, handle others with pure code, all inside a single `Create Hook`.

evidence.title: README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: - **TypeScript Hooks** — `Create` and `Next` hooks intercept every request; built-in V8 engine - **Native MCP Support** — Connect tools via process, SSE, or STDIO transport - **Memory API** — Four scopes: request-level, session, user, team - **Multi-Agent** — Delegate to specialist agents or call agents in parallel - **CLI Agent / Sandbox** — Run Claude Code (or other CLI runners) in an isolated container with VNC desktop support - **Skills Ecosystem** — Drop reusable capability packs (`SKILL.md`) into any CLI Agent

evidence.title: README (segment 8)
evidence.excerpt: - **Data Models** — Define database tables and relations in JSON/YAML - **REST APIs** — Map routes to model queries or TypeScript processors - **SUI Pages** — Component-based web UI with server-side rendering - **Chat UI (CUI)** — Built-in conversation interface for agents - **TypeScript** — Built-in V8 engine; no Node.js required - **Single Binary** — Runs on ARM64/x64; no Python, Node, or containers needed on the host

readme.text:
## ⚠️ Repository Archive Notice

**This repository will be archived on December 31, 2026.**

### What This Means

- This repository will no longer be actively maintained after the archive date
  
- The repository will remain available in read-only mode for reference
  
- No further updates, bug fixes, or pull requests will be accepted after December 31, 2026

- Contact your SAP representative for details

### Timeline

- **Now - December 31, 2026**: Limited maintenance (critical issues only)

- **January 1, 2027**: Repository becomes read-only/archived

[![Maintainability](https://api.codeclimate.com/v1/badges/0e6a23344616e29b4ed0/maintainability)](https://codeclimate.com/github/SAP/jenkins-library/maintainability)
[![Test Coverage](https://api.codeclimate.com/v1/badges/0e6a23344616e29b4ed0/test_coverage)](https://codeclimate.com/github/SAP/jenkins-library/test_coverage)
[![Go Report Card](https://goreportcard.com/badge/github.com/SAP/jenkins-library)](https://goreportcard.com/report/github.com/SAP/jenkins-library)
[![REUSE status](https://api.reuse.software/badge/github.com/SAP/jenkins-library)](https://api.reuse.software/info/github.com/SAP/jenkins-library)

## Project Piper Repository

The Project "Piper" offers default pipelines to easily implement CI/CD processes integrating SAP systems. The corresponding "Shared Library" provides a set of "steps" to build your own scenarios beyond defaults.

## User Documentation

If you want to view the User Documentation of Project Piper please follow this [Piper Pages Link][piper-library-user-doc].

## Known Issues

A list of known issues is available on the [GitHub issues page of this project][piper-library-issues].

## How to obtain support

Feel free to open new issues for feature requests, bugs or general feedback on
the [GitHub issues page of this project][piper-library-issues].

Register to our [google group][google-group] in order to get updates or for asking questions.

## Contributing

Read and understand our [contribution guidelines][piper-library-contribution]
before opening a pull request.

[piper-library-user-doc]: https://sap.github.io/jenkins-library/
[piper-library-issues]: https://github.com/SAP/jenkins-library/issues
[piper-library-contribution]: CONTRIBUTING.md
[google-group]: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/project-piper

scout.summary: Meelo is a self-hosted music server focused on rich metadata handling, unique browsing experiences, and support for complex music collections including music videos, B-sides, rare tracks, and album/song versions. It is actively maintained with recent releases addressing bugs and adding features like multi-album artists and area metadata from MusicBrainz.
highlights: Designed specifically for music collectors with advanced metadata and versioning features
Supports first-class music videos and distinguishes between types (e.g., interviews, trailers)
Albums can have multiple artists and release versions; songs support versions to avoid duplication
Recent releases include security-critical dependency updates and mobile app improvements
Active development with clear release notes and contributor engagement
risks: Open dependency dashboard issue suggests potential technical debt or unpatched vulnerabilities if not regularly addressed
Self-hosted setup may present a barrier to non-technical users despite polished UX claims

inventor.summary: Meelo introduces novel metadata modeling for music collections, treating albums and songs as versioned entities with structured relationships (e.g., B-sides, rare tracks, multi-artist albums), while elevating music videos to first-class status with semantic categorization.
highlights: Invents a hierarchical data model where albums have 'releases' and songs have 'versions', enabling deduplication during browsing while preserving variant access
Pioneers explicit classification of music-related video content (music videos vs. interviews vs. trailers) within a self-hosted server context
Automatically detects 'featuring' and duet relationships, reducing manual metadata curation
Introduces support for unofficial and demo album types sourced from embedded metadata or MusicBrainz
Enables multi-album-artist attribution and geographic artist 'areas' via MusicBrainz integration
risks: Complex metadata model may increase onboarding friction or require precise file tagging conventions
Heavy reliance on external metadata sources like MusicBrainz could limit functionality in offline or restricted environments

engineer.summary: Meelo is a TypeScript-based self-hosted music server with a modular architecture spanning frontend, server, and scanner components, containerized via Docker. It emphasizes metadata-rich playback and browsing, supported by structured data modeling for albums, songs, and music videos. The project uses automated dependency management (Renovate), Prisma ORM, and NGINX, with recent releases addressing security vulnerabilities and mobile compatibility.
highlights: Modular codebase with clear separation into 'front', 'server', 'scanner', and 'matcher' directories, indicating a well-structured full-stack architecture
Docker-first deployment strategy using multiple compose files (dev, prod) and an NGINX template, facilitating reproducible environments
Active dependency maintenance evidenced by Renovate config and release notes highlighting vulnerability patches and version bumps
Prisma ORM usage inferred from bug fixes related to database layer, suggesting a typed, maintainable data access pattern
Biome.js configuration present, indicating adoption of modern JavaScript/TypeScript tooling for linting and formatting
risks: Open dependency dashboard issue (E-IS-001) implies potential lag in updating transitive dependencies, risking exposure to known vulnerabilities despite recent patch releases
Tight coupling to external metadata providers like MusicBrainz may complicate offline operation or increase failure modes during library scans
Frequent NGINX config changes (E-RL-001) suggest infrastructure fragility or undocumented deployment nuances that could trip up users during upgrades

skeptic.summary: While Meelo promises advanced metadata handling and a collector-focused experience, its claims of uniqueness and stability are undermined by sparse adoption, unresolved dependency risks, and a lack of concrete evidence for core advertised features.
highlights: Despite bold claims about 'first-class' music video support and automatic featuring detection, no implementation details or validation mechanisms are provided in the available evidence
The project has only 36 forks and 70 open issues relative to 1,144 stars, suggesting limited real-world testing or community contribution beyond passive interest
Recent releases emphasize dependency bumps for security vulnerabilities (E-RL-001), yet an open Dependency Dashboard issue (E-IS-001) indicates ongoing maintenance debt
risks: Overstated feature set: README segments (E-RD-007) describe sophisticated metadata modeling, but absence of schema documentation or test coverage leaves functionality unverifiable
Operational fragility: Repeated NGINX config changes (E-RL-001) and Prisma-related bug fixes (E-RL-003) suggest instability in foundational infrastructure
Sustainability concerns: Sole maintainer activity (all PRs credited to @Arthi-chaud) raises bus factor risk despite apparent feature velocity

scout.summary: Yao is a Go-based open-source runtime that enables building AI agents and full-stack web applications as a single binary. It emphasizes developer control through a hook-based architecture, supports multiple agent execution modes (LLM, CLI sandbox, pure code), and includes built-in features like REST APIs, data modeling, and a V8-powered TypeScript engine.
highlights: Ships as a single binary with no external runtime dependencies (e.g., Python or Node.js) [ID:E-RD-001][ID:E-RD-008].
Offers three composable agent execution modes: LLM, CLI Agent (sandboxed), and Pure Hook (TypeScript) [ID:E-RD-005][ID:E-RD-006].
Provides deep extensibility via Create/Next hooks that intercept all requests for context injection, validation, and orchestration [ID:E-RD-004].
Includes built-in support for MCP (Model Context Protocol), multi-agent delegation, session/user/team-scoped memory, and reusable SKILL packs [ID:E-RD-007].
Enables full-stack development with JSON/YAML-defined data models, REST APIs, server-rendered SUI pages, and a built-in Chat UI [ID:E-RD-008].
risks: Project is in beta (latest release: v1.0.0-beta17), indicating potential instability or breaking changes [ID:E-RL-001].
Heavy reliance on proprietary or third-party LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) may introduce vendor lock-in or cost unpredictability [ID:E-RD-005].
CLI Agent sandboxing claims isolation but lacks public audit details on container security boundaries [ID:E-RD-007].

inventor.summary: Yao introduces a novel, unified runtime architecture that tightly integrates AI agent execution with full-stack web application capabilities in a single Go binary, using a hook-driven model to orchestrate heterogeneous executors (LLM, sandboxed CLI, pure code) while maintaining strong developer control and composability.
highlights: Invents a composable agent execution model where LLMs, sandboxed CLI tools, and deterministic TypeScript hooks share a uniform interface and can be mixed within the same request flow [ID:E-RD-005][ID:E-RD-006].
Embeds a V8-powered TypeScript engine directly into the Go runtime, enabling server-side logic without external dependencies like Node.js [ID:E-RD-007][ID:E-RD-008].
Introduces 'SKILL.md' as a portable unit of agent capability that can be dropped into CLI Agents, suggesting a novel packaging format for reusable AI skills [ID:E-RD-007].
Unifies data modeling, REST API generation, and UI rendering (SUI + CUI) under one declarative system, reducing fragmentation in AI-native app development [ID:E-RD-008].
Architects memory with four explicit scopes (request, session, user, team), providing structured state management across multi-agent interactions [ID:E-RD-007].
risks: The tight coupling of agent execution, web UI, and data layers into a single binary may hinder modular adoption or integration with existing microservice architectures [ID:E-RD-001][ID:E-RD-008].
Proprietary 'SKILL.md' and hook-based orchestration lack standardization, potentially creating ecosystem lock-in despite open-source licensing [ID:E-RD-007].
Beta-stage maturity (v1.0.0-beta17) combined with ambitious scope increases risk of architectural pivots that could invalidate early integrations [ID:E-RL-001].

engineer.summary: Yao is a Go-based runtime that packages AI agent execution and full-stack web application capabilities into a single binary, leveraging a hook-driven architecture to orchestrate multiple execution modes (LLM, CLI sandbox, TypeScript) with built-in support for data modeling, REST APIs, and UI rendering.
highlights: Runs as a self-contained binary with no external dependencies like Python or Node.js, simplifying deployment [ID:E-RD-001][ID:E-RD-008].
Supports three interchangeable agent executors—LLM, CLI Agent (sandboxed), and Pure Hook (TypeScript)—all sharing the same hook interface for flexible request routing [ID:E-RD-005][ID:E-RD-006].
Embeds a V8 engine for server-side TypeScript execution, enabling logic customization without requiring a separate JS runtime [ID:E-RD-007][ID:E-RD-008].
Provides structured memory across four scopes (request, session, user, team) and native MCP support for tool integration via process, SSE, or STDIO [ID:E-RD-007].
Enables rapid full-stack development through declarative data models (JSON/YAML), auto-generated REST APIs, and built-in SUI/CUI interfaces [ID:E-RD-008].
risks: Project is still in beta (v1.0.0-beta17), suggesting potential instability or breaking API changes [ID:E-RL-001].
CLI Agent sandboxing claims isolation but lacks public details on container security guarantees or attack surface [ID:E-RD-007].
Heavy use of proprietary patterns (e.g., SKILL.md, hook orchestration) may limit interoperability despite open-source availability [ID:E-RD-007].

skeptic.summary: Yao presents an ambitious all-in-one runtime for AI agents and web apps, but its beta status, vague security claims, and reliance on unproven abstractions raise significant concerns about production readiness, maintainability, and actual isolation guarantees.
highlights: Claims of 'sandbox isolation' for CLI Agents lack technical substantiation or audit trails [ID:E-RD-007].
Despite being open-source, the project depends on proprietary LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic), undermining true autonomy [ID:E-RD-005].
The 'single binary' promise simplifies deployment but may obscure complexity and hinder debugging or incremental adoption [ID:E-RD-001][ID:E-RD-008].
Recent releases focus on internal tooling (e.g., secret connectors, robot handlers) with no user-facing stability indicators [ID:E-RL-001][ID:E-RL-002][ID:E-RL-003].
The 'SKILL.md' ecosystem and hook-based orchestration are undocumented standards that could lock users into Yao’s evolving architecture [ID:E-RD-007].
risks: No evidence of security audits or threat modeling for the CLI Agent sandbox, despite claims of containerized isolation [ID:E-RD-007].

Beta releases (up to v1.0.0-beta17) show active churn but minimal public issue tracking—only 1 open issue despite 7.5k stars—suggesting possible lack of community scrutiny [ID:E-RL-001][ID:repo_profile].
Tight integration of AI, data, and UI layers in one binary increases blast radius; a flaw in one component could compromise the entire system [ID:E-RD-008].
V8 engine embedding introduces a large attack surface (memory safety, JS sandboxing) without clear mitigation strategies disclosed [ID:E-RD-007][ID:E-RD-008].
Heavy emphasis on proprietary patterns (e.g., hooks, SKILL packs) may fragment the AI tooling ecosystem rather than interoperate with emerging standards like MCP [ID:E-RD-004][ID:E-RD-007].

skeptic.summary: Despite claims of active maintenance and robust CI/CD capabilities, the SAP/jenkins-library exhibits concerning signs of fragility, including a known critical bug in Helm handling, imminent archival, and dependency churn that undermine its reliability for production use.
highlights: The repository is scheduled for archival after December 31, 2026, rendering it a dead-end solution for long-term CI/CD investments [E-RD-001].

Frequent automated dependency updates and rollbacks (e.g., yaml libraries, Helm, Spring) suggest instability in core integrations [E-RL-002, E-RL-003].

risks: Adopting this library locks users into a deprecated tool with no support beyond 2026, despite current activity [E-RD-001].
Silent parameter omission in `helmExecute` could lead to undetected misconfigurations in critical deployment workflows [E-IS-002].
Heavy reliance on automated dependency updates without clear stability guarantees increases risk of breaking changes or regressions [E-RL-002, E-RL-003].
Disabling of Code Climate publishing [E-RL-001] undermines the credibility of the maintainability badge [E-RD-002], suggesting declining code health oversight.
